description: Write and review software design documents through interactive discovery: ask the user targeted questions about the problem, the trade-offs, the alternatives, and the impacted teams, then write (or improve) a clear, trade-off-focused Markdown design doc. Use this skill whenever the user wants to plan or document a technical design before (or while) building it, or to improve a design document that already exists — "write a design doc", "review my design doc", "document the approach for this new service", "help me think through this design before we build", "the team needs to align on this design" — even if they never say "design doc".

results.query: the team needs to align on how we'll do multi-region failover for the API. help me draft a design we can circulate for feedback

i'm about to build a real-time presence service (who's online) for our chat app. before i write code i want to think through the design — write a design doc with me, we can figure out the approach and trade-offs
write an RFC for migrating our monolith's billing module into a separate service — cover the why, the cutover plan, and what could go wrong
review my design doc for the new rate-limiter, it's in docs/designs/rate-limiter.md — i think it's missing the failure modes and i'm not sure the alternatives section is honest
help me think through the design of our webhook delivery system before we build it — retries, ordering, idempotency, the whole thing
document the approach for the new search feature — we're considering Elasticsearch vs Postgres full-text vs Algolia, and i want the trade-offs laid out for each
preciso escrever um documento de design pra nova pipeline de ingestão de eventos, com as alternativas que a gente considerou
we're redesigning auth to support SSO and SCIM. i need a technical design document the security team can review and sign off on
draft a design proposal for sharding our Postgres — i want it to honestly weigh the operational cost against the scaling benefit
my manager asked for a one-pager design before i start the caching layer work. can you help me write it so it covers the problem and the options?
create the C4 component diagram for the billing service in our workspace.dsl
we decided to go with Terraform over Pulumi for IaC — record that decision with the rationale
write the API reference docs for our public REST endpoints, with example requests and responses
draw the sequence diagram for the OAuth login flow as a mermaid block for the wiki
implement the rate limiter we designed last week — here's the doc, just write the code
write a PRD for the new referral program — target users, success metrics, scope
review this pull request for the payments refactor and leave comments
summarize this 40-page design doc into a few bullet points for the exec update
create a project plan with milestones and timelines for the Q3 platform work
what makes a good design doc? give me some tips
